method: Every decoded RGBA frame is hashed. Frame 0 plus every exact zero-threshold changed-pixel bounding-box crop is visually inspected at 1:1 scale in chronological order. Unchanged pixels reuse the preceding reviewed frame; exact full-frame repeats map to their first representative. This is complete coverage, not temporal or perceptual sampling.

reconstruction_invariant.result: Starting from frame 0 and applying each exact crop at its recorded bbox reconstructs every decoded frame exactly; zero pixel mismatches across all 774 frames. Frames with no delta crop were verified identical to the preceding displayed frame.

playback.result: Timed playback completed; beginning/middle/end checkpoints supplemented complete frame review.
